Orthogonal idempotent lifts yield precisely the vertex-shear parameters, and each arrow corner yields a nonzero scale. The coordinate formulas respect all products on arbitrary finitely supported elements and have explicit inverses. Units have eventually constant invertible diagonal plus finitely many arrows; direct conjugation yields exactly finitely supported affine parameters, with a converse unit construction. The local-inner and non-inner assertions follow from finite-coordinate truncation and an infinite-support example. Direct multiplication-table and unit tests cover 932 finite truncation instances; these support but do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The primary source creates an explicit non-Noetherian ring with asymmetric homological dimensions; its full automorphism group is an independently natural structure invariant. The sharp identification of inner conjugations with finite-support sequences, against all allowable automorphisms indexed by arbitrary sequences, exhibits a concrete, full local-to-global failure: every automorphism is locally inner, but the outer quotient is huge even over F_2. That infinite-support boundary is absent from the finite-vertex string-algebra setting and can guide generalizations to locally finite quivers. The claim is one complete exact classification, not a tiny numerical increment.
